_meta.rubric: tiering variables: endowment quality, tenure security, permitting speed AND variance, fiscal take + ratchet propensity (elasticity of take to price), infrastructure, social licence/consent, FX repatriation, trajectory (the derivative). Market misprices trajectory (12-24mo late both ways), permitting variance inside safe labels, sub-national dispersion, and ratchet risk at price extremes.

throughlines.us_policy_supercycle: silver + copper + uranium ALL added to US critical minerals list Nov-7-2025; FAST-41 at 50 projects; NEPA rescission final Jan-2026; SCOTUS Seven County; DoD equity-stake + price-floor era; S232 tariff premia. Largest positive jurisdictional delta of the decade and the book (AGA/BNKR = AK/NM/NV/ID, all-US) is squarely long it.
throughlines.mexico_scarcity_engine: world #1 silver producer in managed decline (concession freeze + permitting freeze + rising fees) while primary-silver is only ~26% of global supply and price-inelastic -> permittable US/Canada primary-silver ounces carry a genuine scarcity premium; USGS cited the Mexico disruption scenario for silver's listing.
throughlines.trajectory_trade: market prices jurisdiction as static labels, ~12-24mo late both directions. Improving now: Argentina(RIGI), Panama(end-2026 binary), Zambia, Bolivia, Saudi, WA-uranium(review). Deteriorating: DRC ratchet, Zimbabwe, Sahel, Mexico-explorers, Peru-structure.
throughlines.fiscal_ratchet_itm: at $4,674 gold / $69 silver the state's option to re-cut the deal is deep in-the-money everywhere below T1 (Ghana 12% band LIVE, CI stability-override, Indonesia 7-16%, Zimbabwe >$2,500 ratchet). T1 profit-based takes keep the price torque. Structure hedge = royalties/streamers over operators (the GROY logic, vindicated).
throughlines.supply_vs_equity_geography: gold discoveries re-concentrating into T1 (Nevada/WA/Yukon/Finland) while ~25% of production is uninvestable; silver 74% byproduct (price-inelastic); allied zinc declining (Red Dog fade) vs growth in DRC/Russia; uranium 39% behind China/Russia offtake gravity. Scarcity accrues to T1 ounces across every commodity studied.
